rule_outs: Dwelling 5 m from the best section
summary: Short kerb 5 m from university apartment towers, steep, with no-stopping signs.

drivers.seclusion: Bishop and Jarvis Towers (dwellings) sit 5 m from the kerb, windows facing it.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb is a narrow bend beside the buildings; cars already stand at the kerb but room for a van is tight.
drivers.traffic: Campus street with passing traffic and a car park opposite.
drivers.convention: No Stopping signs at both ends of the stretch.

flags: Steep: about 15% mean grade, up to 20%
No Stopping Any Time sign 14.7 m from the kerb line
sun_shade: Tree cover and tall buildings shade the kerb, mostly from the north.
